title: VIBEDATA extensions for Apache Ossie (frozen key set)
description: The closed VIBEDATA payload vocabulary. Each custom_extensions entry with vendor_name VIBEDATA carries a JSON-encoded object of one of these four shapes, chosen by the document component it sits on (model, dataset, relationship, metric). Unknown keys are rejected by ossie.py; new keys arrive by intent with a validator change and tests. Names, handles and references are Ossie SQL identifiers ($defs/identifier); expressions carry x-ossie-expression-kind, an annotation JSON Schema ignores and ossie.py enforces.

dbt_model.description: dbt ref() name that builds this table; aliases name their base model

note.description: Why-not or partial-mapping rationale, recorded where it cannot drift from the entry

partitioned_by.description: Storage partition columns of this physical table, only when it is truly partitioned

levels.description: The dimension's levels (OBIEE logical levels), declared once and shared by its hierarchies

open_ended_value.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) that closes a current version

note.description: Partial-mapping rationale: which columns were refused and why

column_map.description: Logical field or metric name to the physical column of this source

join_cost.description: Relative cost for aggregate ordering, lower wins

content_levels.description: Per dimension role, the level this source holds; a role not listed is aggregated away

content_filter.description: Row predicate over the dataset's fields that every row of this source satisfies, values written as literals; held by a test named in note

navigable.description: false: an engine must not choose this source unless asked by name (population the content_filter cannot state)

is_time.description: Levels order chronologically by their primary keys

scd_rollup.description: Type 2 only: a member rolls up as of the fact's date, or as it is now

join_type.description: SQL join type of the execution join

join_expression.description: The join predicate when it is not the core from/to equi-join, in Ossie FieldExpr grammar: every column is <from or to dataset>.<declared field>

note.description: Why this relationship lacks key-covering to_columns, or why a reachable path has none

to_level.description: Level of the target whose primary key to_columns carry: the join reaches a member of a versioned dimension, not one of its rows

weight.description: Field of the from dataset that allocates a measure entering this relationship from its one side (a weighted bridge); the weights of one member sum to 1

attributes.description: Descriptive fields of a member that identify nothing (a name that repeats)

via.description: Relationship that reaches the dimension (names the role). Omitted only on a dimension's own coarser source, where the level is one of the dataset's own levels

level.description: A level of the target dataset; omitted, the target's own rows

key.description: Which of the level's keys; default its primary key

key_columns.description: Aggregate content only: the source's columns that carry that key, in key-field order

aggregation.description: Rule for rolling a pre-aggregated column up to a coarser grain; NON_ADDITIVE never rolls up

derived_expression.description: Post-aggregation formula over other metrics; the metric binds to no column

at_levels.description: Level-based metric: evaluated at these levels whatever the query groups by

filter.description: OBIEE FILTER(... USING ...): the rows the metric reads, as a predicate over dataset.field columns the core expression also reads

unrelated_dimensions.description: A query that groups or filters by a dimension the metric cannot reach: error (default) rejects the query; total repeats the metric's value without that dimension

of.description: Metric whose value is shifted or accumulated

periods.description: ROLLING only: the current member and periods - 1 before it, in the time dimension's chronological order

rowLevel.description: The level one row of the dataset is. versioned: rows are versions of that level's members (Type 2)

levelKey.description: Fields that identify one member of the level. Every key is unique at its level by declaration

primary.description: Exactly one per level: what joins, aggregate navigation and blending use

display.description: At most one per level: the key shown for a member; default the primary

basedOnDimensions.description: OBIEE dimension-based aggregation rule: evaluate `of` at the query's grain refined by `across`, then apply `rule` across those members

identifier.description: An Ossie SQL identifier (core-spec/expression_language.md, Namespacing and Identifier Resolution): a regular identifier of at most 128 characters, matched case-insensitively, or an ANSI double-quoted identifier (a doubled quote escapes one) for a physical name that needs quoting. Regular identifiers are the portable choice.

relation.description: A physical relation, schema.table or catalog.schema.table, each part an identifier

version.description: The payload generation: every payload carries the current key-set version

expression.description: An Ossie expression (OSSIE_SQL_2026), checked by Ossie's validate_sql_expression and parsed by ossie_sql.py

predicate.description: Boolean at its root (comparison, AND/OR/NOT, IS [NOT] NULL, IN with a value list, BETWEEN, LIKE/ILIKE, a boolean function or column); no aggregate, window or subquery

metricFormula.description: Arithmetic over metric names and scalar functions (NULLIF, COALESCE, CASE, CAST); not a predicate; no aggregate, window or subquery
